turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay got a zero and nobody called me.
Look, I'll own it if I messed up.
"If." The zero went in before anyone called me.
Walk me through exactly what I did wrong with Owen's case. Step by step.
You entered the zero, so you walk me through it. Who decided, and on what basis?
